resources.string: Locks Instagram during your focus hours. Can also hide the feed and Reels, if you choose.

Unscroll reads the screen only in Instagram, web browsers, and the Settings pages that could switch Unscroll off. It uses this to hide the feed, Reels and Explore, and to lock Instagram during your focus hours. Screen content is checked on your phone and discarded immediately. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Your focus ends in %1$s. Unscroll has no stop button.
This setting could switch Unscroll off, so it’s unavailable for %1$s.
Messages, posting and your profile still work.
